$comment: Canonical lead tier configuration. Single source of truth consumed by lead_engine/ scripts, the price sheet builder, the proposal engine and Property/web/src/lib/leads/tiers.ts (drift-tested). Numbers and rules are fixed per the Lead Engine build brief; do not edit without owner sign-off.
$exclusivity: Owner-locked 2026-08-12. Leads are shared (up to claim_slots_per_lead firms). An exclusive claim at exclusive_multiplier x the lead's price locks the lead to the claiming firm, but only if no other firm has claimed it yet; once any firm holds a shared claim, only shared slots remain. A lead's price is fixed at its first claim (no decay repricing between claimants). Credits apply to exclusive claims only.

tiers.label: Adjacent
tiers.note: same lead may be sold here in addition to accounting slots. Non-competing professions only.
